full_text:
Article 6 (Procedure and Method for Preparing Periodic Reports)
① The auditor (hereinafter referred to as "auditor" in this Article), who is the accounting firm for a company listed on the Stock Exchange, shall prepare a report (hereinafter referred to as "periodic report") in accordance with the form specified by the Commissioner of the Financial Supervisory Service, as required by each item of Article 28(3) of the Act on Securities Offerings.
② When submitting a periodic report to the Commissioner of the Financial Supervisory Service pursuant to Article 25(5) of the Act, the auditor shall also submit the materials necessary for the Commissioner to objectively verify the contents of the report.
③ The auditor may submit the periodic report to the Commissioner of the Financial Supervisory Service electronically.
